主要内容: Frost & Sullivan has recognized Kentkart A.Ş with the 2015 European Frost & Sullivan Award for Product Line Strategy Leadership, highlighting its innovative smart transportation solutions. Kentkart's focus on R&D, quality, and service has enabled it to create a product line that enhances the payment system and travel safety. The company's technologies for intelligent transportation systems are helping it claim the top spot in Turkey, where it is one of the few companies with its own R&D department and supported by the Scientific and Technological Research Council of Turkey (TUBITAK). Kentkart's automated fare collection and vehicle management systems provide public transport operators with measurable data, improving operations in terms of quality, economics, and profitability. The company's real-time passenger information system offers up-to-date information on all locations, while its onboard systems and mobile devices stream information during travel. Kentkart's video surveillance systems have significantly improved safety and communication during commutes, with users reporting a substantial decrease in thefts, passenger complaints, and unfortunate incidents. Kentkart carries 1.8 billion passengers with 13 million contactless smart cards annually. Over the past three years, it sold 14 million contactless smart tickets and generated 250,000 new passengers through its solution, KentMobile. KentMobile is a mobile passenger information system that can be downloaded free of charge, enabling users to access information such as vehicle location, the nearest stops, and their credit balance. The company's latest venture is an application that can process the purchase of tickets for public transport, compatible with Android or NFC-enabled smartphones. Future upgrades include the installation of a Bluetooth receiver antenna in the vehicle so that payments can be deducted directly from the smartphone according to the distance traveled.
